format.asset_identity: external SHA-256 plus byte count; no embedded weights

invariants: Model IDs are immutable and duplicate IDs with a changed graph or asset digest are rejected.
Assets are verified by declared ID, byte count and SHA-256; missing or changed assets fail before any tensor call. No download or embedded weight is used.
Tensor names, shapes, dtype and required hooks are frozen by this contract; unknown shapes, hooks or modes are rejected.
Recurrent state has fixed size and must be finite; nonfinite or wrong-sized state is rejected without producing audio.
Offline whole-clip and streaming 160-sample entry points are distinct; a runner admits only its declared mode.
Only model-free stub runtimes and pinned model-free reference digests are present; no real model, weight, license or runtime is claimed.
Public v0 ABI, descriptors, provider registry, adapter protocol and defaults are unchanged.
